name: Enterprise Project and Change Management
constraints: Project identity is established by authorization, declared scope and temporal boundary; tracker containers and products never supply that identity.
ProjectCharter is a serial revisioned authorization artifact owned by the Project aggregate and is superseded rather than overwritten.
WM-ACT-005 owns immutable approved baseline packages and predecessor-to-successor baseline transitions.
WM-ACT-008 owns referenced plan and schedule content, forecasts, actuals and computation provenance.
Every variance names an approved baseline version; forecast, baseline and actual remain distinct.
WM-ACT-031 retains discriminated Milestone, Deliverable and Acceptance identities; a milestone is never inferred from task completion.
Acceptance pins criteria version, verification method, authority, decision time, conditions and evidence.
Existing acceptance evidence survives re-baselining unless an explicit changed deliverable creates a new acceptance basis.
WM-ACT-032 masters ProjectChangeRequest and externally references the decision authority and resolved disposition.
An approved change request cannot issue or mutate a baseline; it triggers creation of a successor baseline with explicit effectivity.
Project-to-product and project-to-tracker-container relations are many-to-many and never collapse subject identity.
Project closure does not close a product and does not erase open changes or residual obligations.
Derived dates and values record their computation run; names, dates and periods are never identifiers.
holds: Baseline ownership and change-register duplication require explicit base-model edits.
Product, tracker, decision and parent relation rows are incomplete.
WM-ACT-031 artifact identity and rollup rules require correction.
WM-ACT-032 mapping and status extracts require re-scoping.
Criteria-version pins and shared-tracker/rebaseline fixtures are not yet present in the canonical bases.
Independent Grok review and one frozen audit remain pending.
